disputes.reason: Defensible as true: Basel III LCR run-off rates for wholesale funding range from 5% to 100%, so 'partial losses of wholesale funding' is arguable; the correction ('complete losses') overstates the rule.

Not judgeable standalone: it is a meta-claim that a given CFaR wording is inaccurate because it is the liquidity risk definition, which needs the four-definition list; the explanation's netted-against-expected CFaR definition also blurs the LaR card.
